La Richesse Silencieuse

Investing guide for salaried members of the African diaspora. It names the pressure to build back home, shows why many of those emotional investments never pay back, and gives a simple method: save, buy index funds, protect the family, and help relatives within a set limit. Comes with an interactive investment simulator.

Le capital entravé

Why Cameroon's economy stalls: work and savings cannot become capital when land titles, rules and institutions fail. A few people title and stockpile land to speculate; most families own something they cannot use as collateral.
